scope: FFT same-leaf-core x dataflow ablation. Every cell uses the same radix-16 digit-reversed algorithm, FP32 arithmetic, input, batch, and output contract. The core axis selects native register-tile or cuFFTDx Thread for the same 16-point arithmetic leaf. The dataflow axis selects a fully stagewise HBM organization or a resident two-stage prefix in CTA shared memory. Launch geometry, occupancy, shared-memory use, and wrapper code are not fixed across organizations.
control_limits: The fixed identity is the arithmetic Core::run leaf, not the entire GPU kernel or launch geometry.
At N256/B1, stagewise launches 16 threads while resident launches 256; changes in parallelism are part of the organization treatment.
The global stage-zero unity-twiddle wrapper is absent from the resident stage-zero source; do not assert identical generated instructions without inspecting the compiled code.
Historical records establish their standalone-binary cohort only; they do not certify the current public-selector build or all butterfly operators.

stagewise-hbm.definition: After digit reversal, every radix-16 stage launches one thread per leaf and reads/writes its complete stage result in HBM. No stage is retained in CTA shared memory.
stagewise-hbm.label: baseline-traditional-stagewise

resident-prefix-2.definition: After the same digit reversal, stages 0 and 1 for each 256-value tile execute as 16 leaves in one CTA and remain in shared memory across the inter-stage barrier. Stages 2 and later use the same global stage kernels and HBM boundaries as the baseline.
resident-prefix-2.label: hybrid-resident-prefix-2
